info.title: svgc
info.description: An Svg drawing markup to C# code generator using SkiaSharp as rendering engine.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Converts a svg file to a C# code.

options.name: inputFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to the input file

options.name: outputFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to the output file

options.name: jsonFile
options.description: The relative or absolute path to the json file

options.name: namespace
options.description: The generated C# namespace name [default: Svg]

options.name: class
options.description: The generated C# class name [default: Generated]
